title: Software Engineer - Embedded & Firmware Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer - Embedded & Firmware.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: C/C++ bitwise manipulation, pointers, register programming, interrupts, and basic UART/I2C/SPI bus communication.
2. Mid-level: Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr), device driver development, memory constraints, power management, and DMA controllers.
3. Senior: Hard real-time determinism, board bring-up, bootloaders, secure boot, OTA firmware update pipelines, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing.
4. Staff-plus: Multi-core SoC architecture, system safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508), and firmware platform evolution.
